risk_profile: R2 local persistent research, advisory only

invariants.rule: Source quotations resolve to immutable exact spans; attribution is not truth.
Source/model text cannot change rights, values, evaluator, policy or execution authority.
Outcomes append after sealed prediction; no retroactive rewriting.
All serving, model-sharing and export operations honor source ancestry rights and expiry.
Theory/transfer/observational results cannot silently become tested causal facts.
Human goals/values require explicit human approval.
Runtime may read local authorized state and propose; no consequential external action executor.

state_strategy: hybrid SQLite transactional versions and digest-only append journal
legitimate_state: Valid database schema, verified event chain, exact source span anchors, no running orphaned jobs, no unauthorized external executor.
recovery: Restart marks orphaned jobs interrupted; explicit retries <=3; restore checked backup for corrupt authoritative state.
